title: Shopify App Audit
seo: Shopify app audit and code review
meta: A prioritized review of your Shopify app covering code, API use, speed and App Store rules, with an optional call. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Shopify app audit with a prioritized fix list
overview: We review your app against what Shopify expects: API version use, access scopes, webhook handling, billing, embedded app behavior, performance and security basics. You send the repository and Partner Dashboard collaborator access. We return a written report that ranks each finding by effort and impact, so your team knows what to fix first. The larger packages add a call and sample fixes.

pkgs.blurb: A full review with a fix roadmap and a few sample fixes.

faq: Will you change anything in my app?
Not in the audit itself. We read and report. Only the Premium package includes up to three sample fixes, which come as a separate pull request that you can accept or ignore.
Read access to the repository and a view of your Partner Dashboard through a collaborator seat. We do not need store admin access or any passwords.
Does the audit cover Shopify's review requirements?

Yes, in the Standard and Premium packages. We check the items Shopify reviewers commonly flag, such as privacy webhooks, scope use, billing and install behavior, and tell you what to fix before submitting.
Can you fix the findings afterwards?
Yes. We can quote the fixes as a separate piece of work, or you can hand the report to your own team. It is written so another developer can act on it directly.
